description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Priest of Urabrask from your hand onto the battlefield.
Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Hoverguard Sweepers from your hand onto the battlefield.
Hoverguard Sweepers enters the battlefield, returning itself and Priest of Urabrask from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
